blocks.title: Physical-digital twin loop — Digital Twin Platform Engineering
blocks.note: The twin is only as good as its last synchronization; drift is measured on a schedule and flagged rather than trusted.

blocks.x: What holds Digital Twin Platform Engineering together is discipline at the boundaries — typed contracts between stages, versioned releases, and a replay trail for every decision. The diagram above shows how the pieces compose; the gate reviews are what keep them honest.
